general_information.Description: The Graduation Thesis is an integrative experience that brings together various components of the undergraduate international business studies in a more applied setting and under a new perspective. It enables students to further their knowledge and skills in international business and related topics which they have found to be especially interesting or beneficial to them. As part of the course, students will learn about all aspects of the process of developing and carrying out the graduation thesis and gain an understanding of standards and expectations needed to successfully complete their dissertation. This thesis project will be completed by a group of 4-6 students, however each student will defend the thesis individually in front of a thesis committee. Each group of students will be supported by a supervisor, who will provide them with essential guidance in conducting a research, writing a thesis in a formal format and defending their arguments in front of the examination board. The thesis' topic is concerned with such areas as (1) international business strategies, (2) contemporary issues of cross-cultural business management, (3) global entrepreneurship, (4) global human resource management - current practices and future trends, (5) FDI in Vietnam, (6) ethical issues in international business, (7) international trade in the current global geo-political landscape and (8) international business practices towards sustainability.
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify topic background, topic relevance, relevance of research question, overview of dissertation structure.
Conduct an appropriate literature review and review of literature related to the research question.
Clearly state the gap in literature with respect to research questions and with selected theoritical models.
Understand and apply methods used to collect data, data collection methods, sample characteristics, limitations of the research project
Design and implement appropriate qualitative and/or quantitative methods
Systematically present the data before interpretation.
Analyse the data and do discussions of findings relatively to the literature review
Answer to the research question, explain the relevance of answer to practice and make recommendations
Understand what Harvard referencing is and how it would correctly be applied during the process of dissertation
Understand deeply the necessary steps to carry out a research project and to write a structured report/dissertation.
Implement and possess their own project in the application to all types of business model.
Be confident with their final product of dissertation which could be used to apply on solving the real practical problem of the business world
